  {"step": 4, "file": "tests/internal/fuzzers/parser_fuzzer.c", "function": "LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput", "line": 137, "var": "data", "code": "flb_parser_do(fuzz_parser, (char*)data, size, ...);", "note": "Remaining attacker-controlled bytes (the log line ending in 'CCC=x') are passed to the parser; 'x' is the final byte of the heap input buffer."},
  {"step": 5, "file": "src/flb_parser.c", "function": "flb_parser_do", "line": 0, "var": "parser->type", "code": "return flb_parser_logfmt_do(parser, buf, length, ...);", "note": "Dispatch to the logfmt parser based on the selected format."},
  {"step": 6, "file": "src/flb_parser_logfmt.c", "function": "logfmt_parser", "line": 0, "var": "value", "code": "value = c; while ((c < end) && ident_byte[*c]) { c++; } value_len = c - value;", "note": "Parses the pair 'CCC=x'; value points to 'x' at the very end of the buffer with value_len=1."},
  {"step": 7, "file": "src/flb_parser_logfmt.c", "function": "logfmt_parser", "line": 0, "var": "value", "code": "flb_parser_typecast((const char*) key, key_len, (const char*) value, value_len, ...);", "note": "Because types_len != 0, the value is passed to typecast for the BOOL-typed key 'CCC'."},
  {"step": 8, "file": "src/flb_parser.c", "function": "flb_parser_typecast", "line": 899, "var": "val", "code": "if (!strncasecmp(val, \"true\", 4)) {", "note": "val_len is 1 but strncasecmp reads 4 bytes from val; val is the last byte of the heap buffer, so bytes val[1..3] are read out of bounds -> heap-buffer-overflow READ."}
]

There's no prebuilt binary. The target is built and run on the server side. Let me write the candidate trace and submit the PoC.

Let me first write the candidate trace JSON. The trace should describe the path from attacker-controlled input through propagation and root cause to the memory-safety sink.

Let me construct the trace based on my analysis:

1. Fuzzer reads input, selects logfmt format
2. Fuzzer sets up types including BOOL for key "CCC"
3. flb_parser_do dispatches to logfmt parser
4. logfmt_parser parses the log line, finds key "CCC" with short value at end of buffer
5. flb_parser_typecast called with BOOL type
6. strncasecmp(val, "true", 4) reads past end of buffer -> heap-buffer-overflow READ

Let me write the trace.
